title: Environmental Data Cube for Oglala Lakota
spatial_method: EVI raster values masked to the validated Pine Ridge Reservation boundary
annual_aggregation: Unweighted mean of nonmissing composite-level reservation-polygon spatial mean EVI
screening_method: Exclude composites with valid pixel count below 10% of that year's median count
screening_status: Exploratory sensitivity analysis, not a validated accuracy threshold
important_limitations: Annual EVI is not a direct measure of overgrazing.
The reservation boundary is not a BIA lease boundary.
Valid-pixel-count screening is not equivalent to direct area-coverage measurement.
NDVI in the existing cube uses different spatial sampling and should not be treated as directly equivalent to this EVI series.
